title: Evaluation Task Schema
description: DynamoDB table schema for evaluation tasks that compare model predictions against ground truth

Id.description: Primary key - Unique identifier for the evaluation task (UUID)

Name.description: Name or title of the evaluation task
Name.example: Nova MME vs Ground Truth - Product Demo Evaluation

Description.description: Description of the evaluation task, including evaluation criteria and objectives
Description.example: Evaluate Nova MME model performance against manually labeled ground truth for product demonstration detection

VideoId.description: Foreign key reference to the video table

VideoAnalyzeTaskId.description: Foreign key reference to the video analyze task being evaluated

GroundTruthId.description: Foreign key reference to the ground truth table

CreatedBy.description: User who created the evaluation task (from Cognito)

CreatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the evaluation task was created

CompletedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the evaluation task was completed

Status.description: Current status of the evaluation task

Labels.description: Array of labeled segments with timestamps and scores from evaluation results

Score.description: Score value (MME search distance, confidence score, or similarity metric)

Label.description: Optional label or category for the segment

ReviewResult.description: Review result classification for the label

EvaluationMetrics.description: Evaluation result metrics comparing predictions against ground truth

F1Score.description: F1 score (harmonic mean of precision and recall)

Accuracy.description: Accuracy score ((TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN))

MeanIoU.description: Mean Intersection over Union for temporal segment overlap

MeanAveragePrecision.description: Mean Average Precision (mAP) across all classes

ground_truth_id-index.description: GSI for querying evaluation tasks by ground truth ID

video_id-index.description: GSI for querying evaluation tasks by video ID

video_analyze_task_id-index.description: GSI for querying evaluation tasks by video analyze task ID

examples.Name: Nova MME vs Ground Truth - Product Demo Evaluation
examples.Description: Evaluate Nova MME model performance against manually labeled ground truth for product demonstration detection

examples.Name: TLabs MME Evaluation - Scene Segmentation
examples.Description: Compare TLabs MME predictions with manual scene segmentation ground truth

dynamodb_specifics: GroundTruthId-index GSI enables efficient queries for all evaluation tasks related to a ground truth
VideoId-index GSI enables efficient queries for all evaluation tasks related to a video
VideoAnalyzeTaskId-index GSI enables efficient queries for all evaluation tasks related to an analyze task
All field names use PascalCase convention for consistency
usage: Evaluation tasks compare model predictions (stored in Labels) against ground truth annotations
Labels array stores the search results/predictions from the model that were evaluated
EvaluationMetrics section stores computed performance metrics after evaluation completes
Each evaluation task links a specific analyze task to a ground truth for comparison
related_tables: video_eval_analyze_table - Source analyze task being evaluated
